messages.subject: Re: [RFS] r-gran-ecosolver
messages.body_plain:
Hi Rodrigo,

thanks for your work on this package.

On Mon, Jun 01, 2020 at 08:45:37PM -0300, Rodrigo Carvalho wrote:
> Hi,
> I have pushed a new R package into salsa[1].
> Could you review it?
> The ITP bug is #961835
> 
> [1] https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team/r-cran-ecosolver

As Dylan said in his last mail, please use

   prepare_missing_cran_package ECOSolveR

to create this package.  On one hand it will save you a lot of time on
the other hand the repository created should be valid regarding
pristine-tar.  I simply get

r-cran-ecosolver(master) $ gbp buildpackage
gbp:info: Building with (cowbuilder) for sid
gbp:info: Tarballs 'r-cran-ecosolver_0.5.3+dfsg.orig.tar.gz' not found at '../tarballs/'
gbp:info: Creating ../build-area/r-cran-ecosolver_0.5.3+dfsg.orig.tar.gz
gbp:error: Can not find pristine tar commit for archive 'r-cran-ecosolver_0.5.3+dfsg.orig.tar.gz'

which I never observed when using prepare_missing_cran_package.  While
it would be probably easy to fix I'd suggest you follow the hint above
to learn how to do things easily and correct.

Kind regards and thanks for your involvement in any case

       Andreas.

-- 
http://fam-tille.de

messages.subject: Re: [RFS] r-cran-gmp
messages.body_plain:
In the mean time,  the maintainer  Antoine Lucas  has released
gmp_0.6-0  to CRAN .. where I had previously changed all occurrences
of  'GPL'  to 'GPL-3'.
I hope this will be helpful for you when debian-packaging r-cran-gmp.

Best regards,
Martin

On Sat, May 30, 2020 at 7:23 AM Andreas Tille <tille at debian.org> wrote:

> On Fri, May 29, 2020 at 09:59:44PM +0200, Martin Maechler wrote:
> > (similar to myself) they are mathematicians and researchers
> > who want to do science and development for the public good, and not
> > spend time on boring lawyer's stuff  (;-)..
>
> I'm physicist and can perfectly understand.  I'm doing Debian packaging
> since more than 20 years and can confirm that editing the copyright file
> is the most boring stuff in this.  Wait, even more boring is getting a
> package rejected by ftpmaster due to a license conflict is even more
> boring.  This is what will happen as Dylan said in his mail.  So if you
> ask me changing just the number takes less time than writing lots of
> e-mails about it. ;-)
>
> Kind regards and thanks a lot for your open words
>
>       Andreas.
>
> --
> http://fam-tille.de
>

-- 
Martin Maechler,
Seminar fuer Statistik, ETH Zurich
